title: Boss Lair Rainbows
description: Boss Lair Rainbows — The Townstons wiki
html:
Most bosses drop from the same shared mythic pile. The named pieces people call Sissirat's or Manglefeet's are not on that pile. They sit on the chest in that boss lair. The Wishing Well can spit the same names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Drop odds for the shared pile, the ordinary chest roll, and this special chest roll are on Rainbow Drops. Which shared-pool names can show at your level is on Rainbow Level Bands.

Contents

  • 1 How it works
  • 2 The lists
  • 3 Level floors
  • 4 HDoL

How it works

From Algernon on, the treasure room after the fight has a boss chest. That chest still rolls ordinary loot, including a slow shot at the shared mythic pile. On top of that it has a special about 1 in 180 for one name from that lair's short list.

Rattle Tooth in Dew Valley has no boss chest and no named list.

These named pieces are not in the shared table every boss corpse rolls. Killing Sissirat will not make Manglefeet's chair show up on the body. You want that chest, or the Well once you are in that dungeon's level range.

The lists

Rattle Tooth

Rattle Tooth in Dew Valley.

Rattle Tooth has no boss chest and no named list. The corpse still rolls the shared pile once you are 15.

Sissirat

Sissirat in Algernon. Named roll from 15. You can walk the dungeon earlier.

  • Sissirat's Super Sissy Stick of Stench
  • Sissirat's Super Sissy Smasher of Stench
  • Sissirat's Sissy Spitter

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Algor the Cold

Algor the Cold in Algor's Terror Dome. Named roll from 15. Dungeon from 10.

  • Algor's Axe of Global Warming Protection
  • Icicle Pop Ring
  • Algor's Freeze Popper

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Vergrim

Vergrim in Vergrim's Vexation. Named roll from 15.

  • Vergrim's Very Spiffy Robe of Divine Power
  • Vergrim's Protective Headgear of the Goshly Wisker
  • Vergrim's Fancy Gloves

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Widow Maker

Widow Maker in The Widower's Nest. Named roll from 20.

  • I Got Next Game
  • I Got Last Game
  • I Won the Game and All I Got Was This Stupid Ring

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Frump

Frump in Frump's Misfortune. Named roll from 25.

  • Doesn't Suck Charm

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Rotgut the Bloated

Rotgut the Bloated in The Mutanous Malaise. Named roll from 30.

  • Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone
  • Sound Blaster

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Abaddon

Abaddon in Embercore Path. Named roll from 45.

  • Abaddon's Handy Candy Cane
  • Abaddon's Handy Candy Broomstick
  • Abaddon's Hardened Candy Corn Cowl

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Queen of Shadows

Queen of Shadows in The Shadow's Embrace. Named roll from 50.

  • Shadow Queen's Ring of Brilliant Light!

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Balzack

Balzack in Balzack's Burrow. Named roll from 55.

  • Dance Shoes of the Burrow
  • Balzack's Dance Decoder Ring of The Mutant Samba
  • Long Stem Rose of Balzack's Everlasting Tango

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Ratsputin

Ratsputin in Ratsputin's Gulag. Named roll from 75.

  • Ratsputen's Crown of Icy Goodness
  • Ratsputin's Icy Sword of Whisker Power
  • Ratsputin's Frosted Forest Snow Globe Ring

The crown really is spelled Ratsputen on the item.

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Manglefeet

Manglefeet in Mutant Mania. Named roll from 80. No maximum.

  • Folding Chair of the Mangled Foot
  • Manglefeet's Championship Ring
  • Nacho Supreme

The helm slot on that chest is Nacho Supreme. It is better known as a Wishing Well piece and always felt half-finished.

The Well can also spit these names once you are high enough for that dungeon.

Level floors

The named chest roll will not fire below the character level in this table. There is no maximum. A 100 still gets the same list. The piece comes out at your level.

The Wishing Well uses the same dungeon floors. Early lairs still sit on the mythic floor of 15 even if you can walk into the dungeon sooner.

BossNamed roll from
Sissirat15
Algor the Cold15
Vergrim15
Widow Maker20
Frump25
Rotgut the Bloated30
Abaddon45
Queen of Shadows50
Balzack55
Ratsputin75
Manglefeet80

Five on Insane is about 1 in 14 for some name from that list, and about 1 in 43 for one specific name when the list has three. How loot percent, party split, and under-level groups change that is on Boss-Exclusive Rainbow Farming.

HDoL

Bosses in the Horrific Dungeon of Legend still roll the shared pile, just hotter. They do not have their own unique rainbow names. Odds are on Rainbow Drops.
